text:
maria: Thinking aloud — should we add model-awareness to routing decisions? e.g., route based on model_family + quantization + compliance_flag so customers get the right variant by region.

sam: short answer: yes if we can keep latency SLOs predictable. :thinking:

lee: model-aware routing sounds useful for cost/quality tradeoffs, but KV cache invalidation gets tricky when model_id changes. we need per-model cache keys.

anita: agree with lee. also require telemetry: model_id, quant_level, route_reason on every request so we can audit/regress. add to launch criteria.

ryan_ops: capacity note — routing by model variant multiplies headcount of warm pools unless we allow fallback to compatible variants. need explicit fallback policy in spec.

maria: proposed MVP scope: 1) add a routing predicate that tags requests by capability tag (safety/compliance/latency_class), 2) route to model variants only when tag matches exactly, 3) fallback policy: allow compatible_family fallback with isolated throttles. keep default to current behavior.

sam: for prioritization, this maps to customer asks: EU-regulated customers want certified models regionally. we should offer a dedicated regional rule first, then model-aware routing as paid addon. that helps sales.

lee: technical checklist (draft):
```
- routing predicate infra (policy engine)
- model metadata registry (family, quant, cert flags)
- per-variant KV cache namespace
- fallback wiring + rate limiter caps
- telemetry + eval hooks
```

anita: launch criteria suggestion:
- telemetry shows correct routing >=99% for test traffic
- no P50/P95 regressions >10% vs baseline for core customers
- canary rollout for 1 week with auto-rollback on quality regressions
- docs + console UI to pin variants per-route

ryan_ops: SLA contract implications: must call out tail latency SLOs per-route. recommend we limit experimental model-aware routes to non-critical SLAs until proven. also add capacity estimates tool in console (approx cost delta).

maria: negotiation point for product: do we accept full per-tenant isolation (reserved warm pools per-variant) in scope now? that blows up infra. alternative: soft isolation = weighted preferential routing + burst capacity.

sam: product vote: prioritize soft isolation + policy engine in Q3, reserve dedicated warm pools for top 3 enterprise customers as part of Dedicated offering. :+1:

lee: ops todo: prototype policy engine that returns (target_variant, fallback_list, reason). keep response tiny. I'll sketch API next week.

deploy-bot: CI Pipeline: model-aware-routing/proto merged to staging — build 0.43.2 — tests running (link: https://ci.redwood/internal/1234).

anita: follow-ups: I'll write the telemetry schema and required eval prompts. maria, can you add customer asks to the PRD?

maria: on it. will add migration plan + rollout checklist. thanks all. :rocket:
